limits: The full DB runner checked the final server/test/harness bytes; two subsequent UI-only refinements were built and checked on the clean clone and in the browser at finalUiCommit.

Browser faults were controlled network interception, not naturally occurring outages. The compiled review runtime used development configuration over loopback and a disposable PostgreSQL database; this is not public/TLS deployment proof.

The initial browser harness waited for incorrect validation copy; after correcting the harness, a real repeated-invalid-focus issue was fixed in 7b755ce. Two separate deliberate normal saves contain the same text; they have distinct intents, not duplicate rows from one retry.
B peer acceptance, G3/G4/G5 completion and main release remain pending. Native browser 200% zoom was not separately verified.
